title: bug: stale comments/docs left after CQ-F (approvedPlanRevision, launcher stamping, submit_plan requiredChecks)
description:
Comment/doc drift found in CQ-F12's epic sweep (no behavior change needed):
1) packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts:802-803 says an absent approvedPlanRevision includes "an omitted-token human approval", but CQ-F04b deleted that path (token-free human approvals are refused INVALID_INPUT).
2) scripts/moe-agent.sh:1352,6273 and moe-agent.ps1:1157,5711 say moe-proxy stamps identity only onto get_context/start_step; since CQ-F12a it also stamps complete_step/complete_task (a wrapper edit hot-reloads the fleet, so land it deliberately).
3) docs/MCP_SERVER.md submit_plan executionContract listing (~line 311) omits the ninth field requiredChecks (CQ-V01a; EXECUTION_CONTRACT_FIELDS in state/validators.ts).
definitionOfDone: The three stale statements match the code at HEAD
F12b drift test (src/util/executionContractDocs.test.ts) and parity-check.sh stay green

implementationPlan.description: Extend executionContractDocs.test.ts first. In the moe.submit_plan parameter block compare documented executionContract property names against imported EXECUTION_CONTRACT_FIELDS, not an occurrence elsewhere in MCP_SERVER. Assert requiredChecks object-array shape and distinct bound wording. Read schema.ts and each launcher via repoRoot, normalize CRLF, and pin bounded comments around approvedPlanRevision plus execution-identity/pin/preflight blocks: no present-tense omitted-token approval claim, session on all four named tools, attempt pair only on start_step/complete_step/complete_task. Keep existing F12b tests unchanged; missing file/section error handling must throw, never skip or match unrelated nearby prose. Guard exact behaviors, not entire prose paragraphs.

Correct only the approvedPlanRevision documentation comment in schema.ts: absence can be historical unchecked/legacy approval or relaxed set_task_status; current human approvals require expectedPlanRevision and omission is INVALID_INPUT; historical rows are never backfilled. In MCP_SERVER.md's submit_plan executionContract listing add requiredChecks with the existing ProtectedCheckDefinition fields id/command/configs/scripts/assertionRoots and document <=20 definitions separately from <=50-item string lists (reuse/link the existing schema details). No type declarations, validators or runtime behavior changes.

Update BOTH launchers' stale identity comments at Grok env generation, attempt-pinning header and MOE_SESSION_ID preflight export. State sessionId is stamped on get_context/start_step/complete_step/complete_task; attemptId+generation only on the last three. Reference CQ-F09/F12a where useful, preserving unset behavior. Only comment text changes: no exported values, interpolation, quoting, Python/PowerShell code or line-ending conversion. Keep twins semantically equivalent and tell the operator in the completion note that delivery of wrapper comments can trigger normal hot reload; do not restart services yourself.

Single final verification gate from repository root: `bash -n scripts/moe-agent.sh && powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command '$tokens=$null; $errors=$null; [void][System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile((Resolve-Path ./scripts/moe-agent.ps1),[ref]$tokens,[ref]$errors); if($errors.Count){$errors; exit 1}' && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh && node --test scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs && (cd packages/moe-daemon && npx tsc --noEmit && npm test) && (cd packages/moe-proxy && npm test) && npm run lint`. Run against a stable full candidate snapshot with docs and all declared files present, native dependencies and clean MOE_* test environment; do not rebuild/delete dist under live proxies. Native Windows PowerShell parses the PS1 twin; Bash and Node tests cover Unix/Git Bash. Require all new drift cases and full daemon/proxy suites pass, and supported Windows launcher branches actually execute (not blanket skipped). Capture fresh command/exitCode/outputTail for complete_task. Schema executable types and wire shapes are unchanged, but this epic-final follow-up retains the daemon/proxy integration suites rather than a test-file-only gate.

Final adversarial self-review once: trace the three statements to the current approval validator, proxy identity map and execution-contract validator, then inspect the whole CQ-F documentation flow for contradictory approval/receipt/evidence claims. Within this task every launcher/schema diff must be comment-only; MCP listing must distinguish requiredChecks objects from checkRefs strings. Ensure tests fail if any one corrected statement regresses and are scoped to owning sections. Preserve historical unstamped approvals, rendered-token CAS, protected fail-closed behavior and existing full-epic tests. Record any unrelated new defects rather than growing this scope; rerun the same gate if review makes fixes.

comments.content:
architect-2c9d5121 (2026-10-27): I added CQ-C07a (task-a50bf5b5d9a4442b88a33554ee5b967f) to this row's dependsOn.

Why: your plan edits comments in packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts, and C07a adds three daemon-owned Task fields to the same file. The epic rail serializes overlapping affectedFiles. The dependency also keeps this row's planned schema.ts path from contesting C07a's landing (mem pattern-architect-overlap-scan-before-submit).

This row was already gated on c2a900aa, so it costs nothing extra.

To undo: set_task_dependencies {taskId: this row, dependsOn: [task-72184c6505cc41e8b6066732011ffb70, task-c2a900aa5107479aa4c630f1b3837ed0]}.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Comment/reference correction only, plus regression guards in the existing F12b drift test. No runtime/wire/schema shape changes. F12 completion is landed/merged and supplies the code, although REVIEW keeps the dependency gate. Added c2a900aa dependency serializes these wrapper/docs edits behind the previously planned wrapper chain; do not edit before claim eligibility.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: approvedPlanRevision comment retains omitted-token language; current WS/MCP approval rejects omission. Proxy EXECUTION_IDENTITY_TOOLS maps get_context to session only and the three progression tools to session+attempt. Both launchers have three related comment sites, including the pin_attempt_identity/Pin-AttemptIdentity header. EXECUTION_CONTRACT_FIELDS has nine members; requiredChecks is a ProtectedCheckDefinition[] capped at 20, not one of the <=50 string lists. executionContractDocs.test currently guards SCHEMA.md's field list but not submit_plan's parameter block.
planningNotes.risks: Wrapper comments still trigger hot reload; coordinate the final delivery, never manually restart the fleet. Preserve peer bytes and use wrappers for Git. Do not misstate attempt identity on get_context or revive token-free approval compatibility. Required-check metadata is approval material, never evidence/readiness. isEpicFinal is true, so include fresh full daemon/proxy plus launcher contract gates, and an epic-scope doc/adversarial sweep without expanding implementation scope.
